ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous blobs are localized at the distal tips of both lobes. A dense network of white linear streaks radiates from the left distal tip toward the center. High-frequency, low-diameter white circular points are scattered across the dark medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 68 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2 to 8 pixels along the trailing edge. A distinct, larger concave indentation is visible at the extreme right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge boundaries of both the left and right lobes from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (2-12 pixel diameter) distributed across the dark field of both lobes, suggesting localized surface scarring or prior colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of at least 8 parallel, high-intensity linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe. A wide vertical cluster of linear abrasions is visible on the right lobe adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the left lobe and white pigmented traumatic scarring at both distal tips; vertical brush-like abrasion on the inner right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The parallel alignment and high contrast of the rake marks on the left lobe form a highly unique 'grid' pattern.
